name: Human Development Index
note: Composite index of life expectancy, education, and GNI per capita; 1990-2023 annual time series for ~193 countries

name: Human Development Index Rank
note: Country rank on HDI; ordinal position among ~193 countries annually

name: Life Expectancy at Birth
note: Life expectancy (years) used as HDI health component; HDR-harmonized series distinct from WB SP.DYN.LE00.IN

name: Expected Years of Schooling
note: Expected years of schooling for children of school-entry age; HDI education component

name: Mean Years of Schooling
note: Average years of schooling for adults 25+; HDI education component

name: Gross National Income Per Capita (PPP 2017 USD)
note: GNI per capita in constant 2017 PPP international $; HDI income component; HDR-harmonized

name: Inequality-Adjusted Human Development Index
note: HDI adjusted for inequality in health, education, and income; discount from HDI captures inequality penalty

name: Overall Loss in HDI Due to Inequality (%)
note: Percentage difference between HDI and IHDI; overall inequality penalty on human development

name: Inequality in Life Expectancy
note: Atkinson measure of inequality in distribution of expected length of life within a country

name: Inequality in Education
note: Atkinson measure of inequality in years of schooling distribution; captures within-country education gap

name: Inequality in Income
note: Atkinson measure of income inequality used in IHDI computation; distinct from Gini

name: Gender Development Index
note: Ratio of female to male HDI; captures gender gaps in health, education, and income dimensions

name: HDI Female
note: Human Development Index computed for female population; component of GDI

name: HDI Male
note: Human Development Index computed for male population; component of GDI

name: Female Life Expectancy at Birth
note: Life expectancy at birth for females; GDI health sub-component

name: Male Life Expectancy at Birth
note: Life expectancy at birth for males; GDI health sub-component

name: Expected Years of Schooling (Female)
note: Expected years of schooling for girls of school-entry age; GDI education sub-component

name: Expected Years of Schooling (Male)

name: Mean Years of Schooling (Female)
note: Mean years of schooling for women aged 25+; GDI education sub-component

name: Mean Years of Schooling (Male)

name: GNI Per Capita (Female, PPP 2017 USD)

name: GNI Per Capita (Male, PPP 2017 USD)
note: Estimated GNI per capita for males; GDI income sub-component

name: Gender Inequality Index

name: Gender Inequality Index Rank

name: Maternal Mortality Ratio

name: Adolescent Birth Rate

name: Male Population with at Least Some Secondary Education (%)

name: Male Share of Parliament Seats (%)

note: Number of refugees hosted by country; UNHCR via OWID; regional stability and burden signal

name: Internally Displaced Persons (count)
note: Number of IDPs due to conflict and violence; UNHCR/IDMC via OWID; internal conflict severity signal

name: Asylum Seekers from Country (count)
note: Pending asylum claims from nationals; UNHCR via OWID; political crisis signal distinct from refugee status

name: Terrorism Deaths (count, GTD)
note: Annual deaths from terrorist attacks; Global Terrorism Database (START/GTD) via OWID; political violence signal

name: Terrorist Attacks (count, GTD)
note: Annual count of terrorist incidents; GTD via OWID; terrorism frequency and instability signal

name: Military Spending (% GDP, SIPRI)
note: Military expenditure as % GDP; SIPRI (CC BY 4.0) via OWID; defence burden and conflict orientation signal

name: Armed Forces Personnel (% Labour Force)
note: Armed forces as % of total labour force; IISS/CoW via OWID; military size relative to economy signal

name: Pre-Tax National Income Gini
note: Gini of pre-tax national income; World Inequality Database (WID) via OWID; market inequality signal distinct from disposable income Gini

name: Post-Tax National Income Gini
note: Gini of post-tax national income; WID via OWID; redistributive effect of fiscal system signal

name: Share in Extreme Poverty (<$2.15/day)
note: Share of population below $2.15/day 2017 PPP; World Bank PIP via OWID; distinct from WB series due to OWID gap-filling

name: Share in Poverty (<$4.00/day)
note: Share below $4/day moderate poverty line; WB PIP via OWID; developing-country standard of living signal

name: Share in Poverty (<$8.30/day)
note: Share below $8.30/day; WB PIP via OWID; upper-middle income poverty threshold signal

name: Reduction in Inequality via Taxes and Transfers (Gini points)
note: Difference between market and disposable income Gini; OWID/LIS computation; fiscal redistribution effectiveness

name: Political Regime Type (Regimes of the World, V-Dem RoW)
note: 4-category classification: closed autocracy/electoral autocracy/electoral democracy/liberal democracy; V-Dem RoW 1900-2025; NOT in existing 109

name: Age of Current Political Regime (years)
note: Years since the current political regime was established; V-Dem ERT via OWID; regime stability signal

name: Autocratization Episode (binary, ERT)
note: Whether country is in an ongoing autocratization episode; V-Dem Episodes of Regime Transformation; regime change signal

name: Democratization Episode (binary, ERT)
note: Whether country is in an ongoing democratization episode; V-Dem ERT; positive regime transition signal

name: Birth Registration Rate (%)
note: Share of children under 5 whose births are registered; UNICEF/World Bank via OWID; administrative state capacity signal

name: World Justice Project Rule of Law Index (Overall)
note: WJP Rule of Law Index; 0-1 scale (1=strongest); OWID-hosted; covers constraints on government, no corruption, open government, fundamental rights, order & security, regulatory enforcement, civil/criminal justice

name: WJP Rule of Law — Absence of Corruption
note: Sub-index of WJP RoL measuring corruption absence in executive, judiciary, police, military; 0-1

name: WJP Rule of Law — Order and Security
note: Sub-index measuring crime control, civil conflict absence, violence against civilians; 0-1

name: WJP Rule of Law — Fundamental Rights
note: Sub-index of civil liberties and fundamental rights protections; 0-1; distinct from V-Dem measures

name: Press Freedom Index (RSF)
note: Reporters Without Borders Press Freedom Index; 0-100 (100=most free); OWID-hosted; media environment signal

name: Food Price Index (FAO, 2014-16=100)
note: FAO Food Price Index; annual average; OWID; food price shock signal relevant to political instability

name: Cereal Yield (tonnes per hectare)
note: Average yield of cereals per hectare; FAO via OWID; agricultural productivity and food security signal

name: Arable Land per Capita (hectares)
note: Arable land per person; FAO via OWID; food security and resource pressure signal

name: Forest Area (% Land Area)
note: Forest coverage as % of land area; FAO via OWID; environmental depletion and resource signal

name: Cumulative CO2 Emissions Per Capita (tonnes)
note: Cumulative historical CO2 per capita; OWID CO2 Dataset; historical responsibility and carbon debt signal

name: Annual Average Temperature Anomaly (°C)
note: Country-level temperature anomaly vs pre-industrial baseline; Berkeley Earth via OWID; climate exposure signal

name: Heat-Related Deaths per 100,000
note: Mortality attributable to heat; various health sources via OWID; climate-health nexus signal

name: Primary Energy Consumption per Capita (kWh)
note: Per capita primary energy consumption; OWID Energy Data (CC BY 4.0); development and industrialization signal

name: Coal Share of Primary Energy (%)
note: Coal as % of total primary energy; OWID Energy Data; energy mix and emissions intensity signal

name: Oil Share of Primary Energy (%)
note: Oil as % of total primary energy; OWID Energy Data; oil dependence and vulnerability signal

name: Natural Gas Share of Primary Energy (%)
note: Natural gas as % of total primary energy; OWID Energy Data; energy mix and import dependence signal

name: Solar Share of Electricity Generation (%)
note: Solar power as % of electricity generation; OWID Energy Data; renewable transition pace signal

name: Wind Share of Electricity Generation (%)
note: Wind power as % of electricity generation; OWID Energy Data; renewable transition pace signal

name: GDP Per Capita (Maddison Project, 2011 USD)
note: Long-run GDP per capita back to 1820; Maddison Project Database via OWID; historical economic trajectory signal

name: Labour Productivity Growth (% annual)
note: Annual growth of GDP per employed person; Penn World Table via OWID; long-run productivity trajectory

name: Multidimensional Poverty Headcount — OWID (Alkire-Foster)
